_comment: Navigation probes: each asserts that a route the documentation tells an agent to take still
leads somewhere. They are deliberately brittle and deliberately specific.
A probe that keeps passing while the thing it describes moves underneath is worse than no
probe, because it certifies a route that no longer leads anywhere. So each names the exact
file a documented recipe would search and the exact shape it would expect to find.
The questions are the ones an agent actually arrives with. If one of these stops matching,
the repository has not merely changed -- it has stopped answering a question it advertises.
